technique_name: Discuss why the given concept has been such a topic of debate within society.
description: Freedom of speech has been a topic of debate within society because it is seen by some as a fundamental human right, while others view it as a source of conflict and division. On the one hand, the right to express opinions freely is important for democracy and for creating a diverse and informed society.
